text:
Priya: Quick note from support audit: the quotas page still lists embeddings as "per-request" in the quickstart calc block. That conflicts with the ratecard CSV which shows per-token. I opened a tiny PR to align examples + add a compact example calc for a 1k-token embedding: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8321
Jules: Thanks. I'll replace the JavaScript snippet that manually parses headers with the SDK helper `usage.fetchRange()` so it's consistent across languages. Planning to include both: SDK-first example + raw-response appendix for integrators.
Anika: On the dashboards side I noticed the docs' Grafana panel link points at an internal folder path that 403s for community users. I can swap to the public metering dashboard and change the panel name to `tokens.ingested.total` if everyone agrees. Will open PR for that link fix (small).
Priya: Yes please change to public dashboard. Also, can we add a migration note that explains the unit change (request -> token) and a short formula folks can copy? e.g., tokens = ceil(char_count / 4) for quick estimates + pointer to tokenizer tool.
Jules: Good call. I'll add a one-paragraph migration blurb and a short code snippet showing the math in Node + Go. Node example I'll add uses the SDK's tokenizer helper:
```js
// node: estimate tokens for_embedding
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })
const approx = client.tokenizer.estimate('some long string here')
console.log(`~${approx} tokens`)
```
Jules: For reviewers: I also updated the header names used in the raw examples to the current stable ones (`X-Usage-Tokens`, `X-Burst-Remaining`) and left a note about older header names mapping (v2/v1) at the bottom of the page.
Victor: I'll regenerate the pricing CSV and the pricing-table.json sample so the docs table and the downloadable CSV match. Will include a column example showing how embeddings are billed per 1k tokens, and a small worked example for a 1k-token batch at the top of the ratecard page.
Anika: Link-fix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8323 — swapped grafana URL + updated panel id to tokens.ingested.total. Ran local link-check, no 403s now.
CI-bot: ci: lint ok for PR 8321, 8323 queued for examples-smoke + link-check
Priya: Plan to land in this order: Anika link-fix -> Jules SDK + migration note -> Victor pricing CSV. Anika's link change is safest to land first so CI doesn't keep failing.
Jules: I'll rebase after Anika merges. Also note: I replaced the code sample that used `fetch('/v1/usage')` with `client.usage.fetchRange()` and formatted the example output to show token totals and cost estimate. Example snippet I'll add:
```go
// go: fetch usage and compute cost
usage, _ := client.Usage.FetchRange(ctx, FetchParams{Start: "2026-02-01", End: "2026-02-07"})
fmt.Println("tokens:", usage.TotalTokens)
fmt.Printf("approx cost: $%.2f\n", usage.TotalTokens/1000.0*0.05) // example rate
```
Victor: Replaced CSV and uploaded pricing-table.json in PR 8325. Also added a tiny note about burst credits and quota window semantics in the FAQ section.
CI-bot: examples-smoke: node+python+go queued for PR 8321; link-check passed for 8323; pricing spec validator flagged minor schema mismatch in 8325 (extra field "notes") — see CI details.
Anika: Merged PR 8323 (grafana link).
Priya: Thanks. Jules, Victor 1F44D please rebase and push fixes for validator. Once CI green, I'll merge Jules then Victor.
Jules: Pushed schema fix and updated README example. PR 8321 updated.
Victor: Dropped the extra "notes" field and fixed the CSV header order. PR 8325 updated.
CI-bot: all checks passed for PR 8321 and PR 8325.
Priya: Merged both. I'll add a short support-ready blurb at the top of the quotas page summarizing the change (embeddings now billed per-token; header changes; where to find the public metering dashboard).
Jules: One small follow-up: we should add an FAQ entry explaining when aggregated server-side usage (client.usage.fetchRange) might differ from raw per-request header totals (aggregation timing, intra-window rounding). I'll open a follow-up minor PR.
Priya: Good idea. If anyone needs me I'll be in #support. Thanks for fast turn-around.
CI-bot: notify: changelog entry auto-created for docs PRs 8321, 8323, 8325.
